android.desc:
A science-based ADHD app for focus, productivity, and daily life. Manage your ADHD in just 5 minutes a day!

Inflow is designed by people with ADHD, for people with ADHD. We are not a glorified timer or calendar. Inflow is a science-based program designed to help you manage focus, procrastination, and follow-through in a way that works with your brain, not against it. Developed with clinical psychologists and featured in peer-reviewed research.

DOES THIS SOUND LIKE YOU? 

Do you struggle with focus, organization, or procrastination? Does "task paralysis" stop you from starting simple chores? Have you abandoned planners and trackers in the past? ADHD doesn’t have to hold you back. Inflow can help.

WHY INFLOW? 

Inflow is based on Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) principles. We don't just give you a tool; we teach you the "why" behind your brain and how to cope when motivation is low.
Thriving starts with understanding your unique neurodivergence. Meet your goals, kick the distraction habit, and create a daily structure adapted to you.

🧠 SCIENCE-BASED MODULES FOR ADHD SUPPORT (CBT-INSPIRED)

Spend less time planning and more time doing. We help you improve skills in:

- Focus and concentration
- Attention and Hyperactivity
- Goal Setting and Consistency
- Time management and routines
- Emotional regulation and self-criticism
- Reducing distraction & Phone addiction
- Impulsivity & Anxiety related to ADHD
- Mindfulness & Nutrition
- Managing RSD (Rejection Sensitive Dysphoria)

🤖 MEET QUINN, YOUR AI ADHD COMPANION 
Stuck in a scroll hole? Overwhelmed by a messy kitchen? Chat with Quinn to think things through and get unstuck!

- Instant Task Breakdown: Ask Quinn to break big projects into manageable steps.
- Judgment-Free Support: Get personalized strategies or just vent without shame.
- 24/7 Availability: Guidance whenever you need it, day or night.

🤝 LIVE BODY DOUBLING & COMMUNITY
You don't have to do this alone.

- Coworking sessions: Join live or on-demand focus rooms. Body doubling is the #1 way to crush procrastination for ADHDers. 
- Supportive Community: Share wins and struggles in a stigma-free space.

Inflow helps you build routines one day at a time. Whether studying, organizing your home, or making space for self-care, our tools help you focus on what matters most.

quotes.text:
To others here, please avoid this app, there are too many red flags about it.

The testimonials on the site [1] are superficial. I only saw short term ones.
Most people with ADHD have a track record of starting new things, being extremely enthusiastic only for it to fizzle out in a few weeks.

Case in point Adam says: "I'm recently diagnosed so it's really exiting..."

This is on the science page [2]:
"Studies have shown that Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) is effective in helping to treat those with ADHD."
It's the only actual science quote on there. It's a platitude if I've ever seen one. 
CBT does work. However how is this app comparable to CBT? It's not and it doesn't explain any of it.

The whole site is also extremely vague and light on detail. No mention on the kind of exercises, why they work and how they work. The screenshots on the playstore page [3] had more info than the site.

As other mentioned the opt-out is indeed predatory given the target audience.

Lastly, there are many great resources online for ADHD:
A community for ADHD go to: https://forums.howtoadhd.com/
podcasts: 
https://drhallowell.com/listen/podcast/
https://www.fasterthannormal.com/

All in all, I'll avoid this app till I hear favorable things from the community.

[1] https://www.getinflow.io
[2] https://www.getinflow.io/science
[3] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=inflow.adhd.productivity
quotes.story_title: Launch HN: Inflow (YC S21) – Self-help app for people with ADHD
